prompt: These waiting room chairs are hard; I wish they (to be) softer.
explanation_ru: После wish для сожаления о настоящем используется Past Simple; с подлежащим they нужна форма were.

prompt: The company never answered my email; I wish they ___ after the interview.
options: replied
had replied
would have replied
have replied
explanation_ru: Для сожаления о завершённом прошлом после wish нужен Past Perfect (had replied). Типичная ошибка — ставить would have или Present Perfect после wish.

prompt: We have maths at eight; I wish we (not / to have) it so early.
explanation_ru: Речь о текущем расписании, поэтому после wish используется отрицательный Past Simple (didn't have).

prompt: Mette wishes the club staff will stop locking the changing room before practice ends.
answer: Mette wishes the club staff would stop locking the changing room before practice ends.
accepted_answers: Mette wishes the club staff would stop locking the changing room before practice ends.
explanation_ru: Для выражения раздражения из-за чьего-то поведения после wish нужен would, а не will — использование will после wish является частой ошибкой.

prompt: Eleni cannot travel through the mountains by train. → Eleni wishes …
answer: Eleni wishes she could travel through the mountains by train.
accepted_answers: Eleni wishes she could travel through the mountains by train.
Eleni wishes that she could travel through the mountains by train.
Eleni wishes she were able to travel through the mountains by train.
Eleni wishes she was able to travel through the mountains by train.
explanation_ru: Невозможность сделать что-то сейчас передаётся конструкцией wish + could + инфинитив.

prompt: Early lectures exhaust Aiko; she wishes she didn't have them at eight.
options: Aiko does not have eight o'clock lectures at university.
Aiko had eight o'clock lectures in the past, not any more.
Aiko has eight o'clock lectures at university.
Aiko wants to sign up for early lectures.
explanation_ru: Wish + отрицательный Past Simple означает, что в реальности сейчас всё наоборот: у Айко есть лекции в восемь утра.

prompt: This street is so grey; if only there (to be) a sunny garden here!
explanation_ru: После if only для мечты о настоящем используется Past Simple; с единственным числом допустимы обе формы — were и was.

prompt: Mathilde works the late shift in a cold office in Brussels. The heating turns off at eight, and she wishes the manager (to stop) turning it down so early. She forgot her thick jumper at home and wishes she (to pack) it in her bag before work. If only the office (to have) better windows!
explanation_ru: Раздражение чужим действием требует wish + would (would stop), сожаление о поступке в прошлом — Past Perfect (had packed), а мечта о настоящем состоянии — Past Simple (had).

prompt: Natalie sits at a desk all day and cannot travel for work.
options: She wishes she could travel for work.
She wishes she can travel for work.
She wishes she will travel for work.
She wishes she had travelled for work.
explanation_ru: Для сожаления об отсутствии возможности сейчас используется wish + could; формы can и will после wish неверны, а Past Perfect относится к прошлому.

prompt: I'm still too nervous at the boxing gym; I wish I ___ into the ring without shaking.
options: would step
can step
could step
will step
explanation_ru: Когда речь о собственной способности, после I wish I ставится could, а не would (конструкция I wish I would — частая ошибка).

prompt: Stuck at the boarding gate in Nice, Folake wishes she (not / to put) her passport in the checked bag.
explanation_ru: Паспорт уже сдан в багаж, поэтому сожаление о прошлом действии выражается через Past Perfect (hadn't put).

prompt: Typing in Exeter's cold library, Leah wishes the heating worked properly so her hands wouldn't freeze.
options: The library heating works well, so Leah's hands stay warm.
The library heating does not work properly, and Leah's hands get cold.
The library heating used to be broken, but it is fixed.
Leah thinks the library is much too warm when she types.
explanation_ru: Wish + утвердительный Past Simple (worked) показывает, что в реальности сейчас отопление работает плохо и руки Лии мёрзнут.

prompt: Whenever it rains hard, the water blocks Daniel's front door; he wishes the broken drain (to stop) flooding the path.
explanation_ru: Чтобы выразить раздражение и желание, чтобы неприятная ситуация прекратилась, после wish используется would + инфинитив (would stop).

prompt: Yuto regrets not having a quiet desk by the window in his office. → Yuto wishes …
answer: Yuto wishes he had a quiet desk by the window in his office.
accepted_answers: Yuto wishes he had a quiet desk by the window in his office.
Yuto wishes that he had a quiet desk by the window in his office.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о текущей ситуации в офисе передаётся конструкцией wish + Past Simple (had).

prompt: Standing at the third gate in Maastricht, we wished the airline had announced the two gate changes earlier.
answer: Standing at the third gate in Maastricht, we wished the airline had announced the two gate changes earlier.
accepted_answers: Standing at the third gate in Maastricht, we wished the airline had announced the two gate changes earlier.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: wished + Past Perfect (had announced) верно передаёт сожаление о действии, которое не произошло раньше.

prompt: Still two years away from finishing her degree in Daejeon, Xinyi cannot open her own design studio yet.
options: She hopes she had her own design studio now.
She wishes she would have her own design studio now.
She wishes she had her own design studio now.
She wishes she has her own design studio now.
explanation_ru: Для нереального желания в настоящем используется wish + Past Simple (had). Типичные ошибки — ставить hope с прошедшим временем или wish с настоящим временем и would.

prompt: Rain hits the Vilnius window; doesn't Ciaran wish he (to live) somewhere warm?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о желании изменить текущее место жительства после wish требуется Past Simple (lived).

prompt: Niklaus wishes he hadn't skipped those morning lectures before the exam.
options: Niklaus attended all the morning lectures.
Niklaus plans to skip the morning lectures.
Niklaus did not have any morning lectures.
Niklaus skipped the morning lectures.
explanation_ru: Отрицательный Past Perfect после wish (hadn't skipped) означает, что в прошлом действие на самом деле произошло: Николаус пропустил лекции.

prompt: Our vegetable garden is completely dry; I wish it ___ soon.
options: would rain
rains
will rain
is raining
explanation_ru: Желание, чтобы погода изменилась в ближайшем будущем, передаётся через wish + would. Формы настоящего времени и will после wish ошибочны.

prompt: Match each beginning with the only ending that fits in grammar and meaning.
pairs: I forgot my jumper, so I wish I
had brought it to the cold hall.
The projector keeps failing, so we wish the college
would buy a new one soon.
My seat is at the back, so I wish I
could see the tiny screen more clearly.
The heater is finally on, so I hope the hall
warms up before the lecture starts.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом требует wish + Past Perfect, желание перемен от других — wish + would, нехватка возможности — wish + could, а реальная надежда на будущее — hope + Present Simple.

prompt: "Why are we still in the car park, Dad?" asked Hana at Seoul airport. "The engine is cold, and I wish this old car (to start) without a fight," her father sighed. "Don't you wish you (to buy) a newer one last winter when prices were low?" "Yes, and if only we (not / to live) so far from the airport!"
explanation_ru: Недовольство тем, что машина отказывается заводиться, передаётся через would start, сожаление о прошлой зиме — через had bought, а нереальное настоящее — через didn't live.

prompt: The red bus in Dubai pulled away from the corner before Zara arrived; she wishes she (to run) a bit faster.
explanation_ru: Автобус уже уехал, поэтому сожаление о прошлом действии строится с Past Perfect (had run).

prompt: Joaquin is sorry that he cannot play his guitar louder in this Barcelona club. → Joaquin wishes …
answer: Joaquin wishes he could play his guitar louder in this Barcelona club.
accepted_answers: Joaquin wishes he could play his guitar louder in this Barcelona club.
Joaquin wishes that he could play his guitar louder in this Barcelona club.
Joaquin wishes he were able to play his guitar louder in this Barcelona club.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о том, что нельзя сделать сейчас из-за ограничений, выражается конструкцией wish + could + инфинитив.

prompt: At nine o'clock, Ravi wishes the neighbour upstairs stops banging on the ceiling.
answer: At nine o'clock, Ravi wishes the neighbour upstairs would stop banging on the ceiling.
accepted_answers: At nine o'clock, Ravi wishes the neighbour upstairs would stop banging on the ceiling.
explanation_ru: После wish нельзя использовать Present Simple (stops): для раздражения от чужого действия требуется would stop.

prompt: Dev stood behind the outdoor stage in Delhi as dark storm clouds gathered overhead. He bitterly wished the drama group (to book) an indoor hall instead of risking an open-air show. Even worse, the wind kept blowing the scripts away, and everyone wished it (to calm) down before the audience arrived. "If only this theatre (to own) a proper roof," Dev muttered to the director.
explanation_ru: Прошлое решение требует Past Perfect (had booked), желание изменения погоды — would calm, а сожаление о текущем положении дел после if only — Past Simple (owned).

prompt: As a guide in the salt mine near Krakow, Stefan often wishes tourists ___ the old wooden beams.
options: won't touch
don't touch
wouldn't touch
haven't touched
explanation_ru: Жалоба на чужое поведение выражается формой wish + wouldn't. Ставить won't, don't или Present Perfect после wish неверно.

prompt: If only Feyza had read both bottle labels carefully before mixing the two cleaning liquids!
options: Feyza read both labels and did not mix the liquids.
Feyza did not read both labels carefully and mixed the liquids.
Feyza never reads bottle labels in chemistry lessons.
Feyza read the labels carefully, so the mixture was safe.
explanation_ru: If only + Past Perfect выражает сожаление о прошлом: в действительности Фейза не прочитала этикетки внимательно и смешала жидкости.

prompt: The old projector died mid-lesson again; Marta wishes the school (to replace) it before the new term began.
explanation_ru: Действие относится к прошлому (до начала семестра), поэтому после wish нужен Past Perfect (had replaced).

prompt: Simge took her phone to a repair shop in Izmir because the battery dies so quickly. She wishes she (not / to download) so many useless apps last month. She also wishes her phone (not / to need) a charger twice a day.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлой установке приложений требует Past Perfect (hadn't downloaded), а о нынешней проблеме со статичным глаголом need — Past Simple (didn't need).

prompt: Working at a support desk in Warsaw, Michal sighs every Monday morning and wishes that angry customer ___ rude emails before nine o'clock.
options: won't keep sending
doesn't keep sending
has stopped sending
would stop sending
explanation_ru: Для раздражения из-за регулярных действий другого человека нужна конструкция wish + would (would stop sending), а не will, Present Simple или Present Perfect.

prompt: After speaking to Kwesi in Accra, his grandfather only wished he had hung up on the fake bank caller immediately instead of listening for ten minutes.
options: The grandfather listened to the fake caller for ten minutes instead of hanging up at once.
The grandfather hung up immediately and never listened to the caller.
The grandfather still talks to the fake bank caller on the phone.
The grandfather gave his bank PIN to the caller before speaking to Kwesi.
explanation_ru: Wished + Past Perfect (had hung up) показывает обратный факт в прошлом: дедушка не повесил трубку сразу, а слушал звонившего десять минут.

prompt: Nikos is tired of waiting because the city refuses to repair the loose stone steps along the steep path at the Athens ruins. → Nikos wishes …
answer: Nikos wishes the city would repair the loose stone steps along the steep path at the Athens ruins.
accepted_answers: Nikos wishes the city would repair the loose stone steps along the steep path at the Athens ruins.
Nikos wishes that the city would repair the loose stone steps along the steep path at the Athens ruins.
explanation_ru: Раздражение из-за бездействия властей и желание перемен передаётся конструкцией wish + would + инфинитив.

prompt: "Has the spare part for the leaking kitchen tap arrived yet?" Okan's mother asked in Ankara. "No, Mum, and I really wish I (to order) it five days ago instead of waiting," Okan sighed. "I wish the courier (to arrive) soon so I can fix the sink before dinner." "If only I (to know) how to repair it without that small metal part!"
explanation_ru: Пропущенное действие в прошлом требует had ordered, нетерпеливое ожидание перемен — would arrive, а сожаление о нехватке знаний сейчас — knew.

prompt: Enzo wrote to his landlord in Naples saying he wished he would have checked the street collection days before leaving the bins outside.
answer: Enzo wrote to his landlord in Naples saying he wished he had checked the street collection days before leaving the bins outside.
accepted_answers: Enzo wrote to his landlord in Naples saying he wished he had checked the street collection days before leaving the bins outside.
explanation_ru: После wish для сожаления о прошлом используется Past Perfect (had checked); конструкция wish + would have — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Pair each start of a beach sentence with its only correct ending.
pairs: The red flag is up, so the lifeguard wishes people
would stay out of the rough sea.
One swimmer dropped his keys and wishes he
had kept them zipped in his pocket.
I am a weak swimmer, and I wish I
could handle my board in big waves.
The wind is dying down, so we hope the water
explanation_ru: Раздражение чужими действиями требует wish + would, сожаление о прошлом — wish + Past Perfect, желание иметь умение — wish + could, а реальная надежда — hope + Present Simple.

prompt: During the rainy season in Kerala, Arjun wishes his small farm (to stand) on higher ground and wishes he (to build) a stronger bridge before the river rose.
explanation_ru: Первое сожаление относится к постоянному положению фермы сейчас (Past Simple — stood), а второе — к невыполненному действию до паводка в прошлом (Past Perfect — had built).
